note: A curated selection, not the whole surface. Add an entry here and it appears in the explorer.

groups.name: Call control
groups.blurb: What happens to a call in progress — hold, transfer, conference, hang up. This is how an agent's button reaches the call.

endpoints.summary: Run one agent action on this node.
endpoints.detail: One endpoint for every action: a name and the fields it needs. Always answers 200 with the result inside, because "the call is not here" is an answer rather than a transport failure.

groups.name: Server management
groups.blurb: Ask a server what it is running, and start or stop it. For your own monitoring and automation.

endpoints.summary: Every Xema service on this machine and what it is doing.
Start, stop or restart one unit.
endpoints.detail: Xema's own services only. Nothing that holds data is started or stopped here.

groups.name: Reporting
groups.blurb: What the floor did, live and historic. The dashboards read these; so can you.

endpoints.summary: Every queue's current state — waiting, longest wait, agents ready.
Answered, abandoned and service level per day.
One agent's day — handled, talk time, wrap, breaks.
endpoints.detail: Authenticated, unlike the rest: it names a person rather than a floor-wide total.

groups.name: Queues
groups.blurb: The queues themselves — who is waiting, and who may be offered a call.

endpoints.summary: Whether the service is up, and what it is running.
Every queue this server is running, with its callers and agents.
Who is waiting in one queue, across the site.
